versions.description:
ADDED:
• Support for offline import from a ZIP archive. Now, if you don’t have a Figma Pro subscription, you can perform an unlimited number of imports without running into Figma API limits. Error 429 will no longer occur. Link to the ZIP Project Exporter tool: (https://shorturl.at/BfvcM)
• New MCP tools that will make your import process even more automated. The GetSyncHelperReasonsTool will help your Agent understand why a particular component was imported in that specific way.
• D.A. Outline support for drawable strokes on supported UGUI image components.
• UniText font-stack generation, mixed-font run handling, and generated combined UniText font stacks.
• Main Settings controls for SyncHelper cleanup after import and the temporarily disabled LayoutUpdater option.
• Ability to copy text from the custom HelpBox that can be seen in some parts of the asset interface.

CHANGED:
• Updated the GitBook manual: added a section on working with the ZIP Project Exporter.
• Renamed the root asset folder from "D.A. Assets" to "DA-Assets".
• Reworked sprite identity hashing into separate object and render hashes for more accurate sprite deduplication.
• Updated Figma node parsing to include cornerSmoothing and itemReverseZIndex.
• Reworked UGUI auto-layout handling for reverse draw order, absolute-positioned children, layout grow, wrap sizing, background-like children, and Figma SCALE constraints.
• Improved generated/downloaded sprite reuse by selecting the largest representative sprite source and validating existing sprite dimensions before reuse.
• Updated sprite colorization to handle generated sprites, avoid recoloring the same asset path multiple times, and reimport updated assets.
• Reworked UniText styling so bold/italic modifiers are applied only when the resolved font face needs them, links handle interactivity separately from visual styling, and gradients can come from graphic fill data.
• Updated ImageLinear material/shader alpha handling with configurable alpha gamma and dithering.

FIXED:
• Sprite duplicate cleanup so imports can pause, resolve default or keep-all choices programmatically, close the duplicate finder when resolved, and redraw objects whose sprite path changed.
• Sprite transform behavior for clipped render bounds, clip-content parents, and sprite render bounds that should not expand layout.
• AutoSlice9 border calculation for rounded vector rectangles, effects, and solid fill/stroke cases.
• Opaque generated PNGs with alpha rounding artifacts by normalizing near-opaque alpha values.
• Linear image material assignment so it is used only for sprites that actually contain transparency.
• Font matching and download naming for Google Fonts subsets, TMP, UITK, and UniText font generation.
• Settings window refresh by updating serialized data and clamping the selected tab index.

REMOVED:
• The legacy FcuInfoTool MCP tool and asset.
